desc: Ideation: N is a 400 number iff N = M^2 where M has exactly 2 distinct prime factors; M <= 10^6.
Implement a sieve up to 10^6 computing distinct prime factor counts (e.g., for each prime p, increment cnt for all multiples).
Build sorted list S = [m*m for m in [2,10^6] with exactly 2 distinct prime factors].
Parse queries with sys.stdin.buffer.read; answer each via bisect_right(S, A) - 1.
Output answers with '\n'.join; sanity-check logic against sample values (404->400, 36->36, 1e12->1e12, 123456789->123454321).
